messages:
maria: Hey team — Zephyr Analytics POC is blocked. CISO is insisting on customer-managed KMS + SSO domain allowlist before we can go live for the week. Need exec signoff on budget bump for Dedicated capacity and a legal answer on the questionnaire. Can someone help prioritize? :exclamation:
jonas: Which KMS flow do they want — bring-your-own or Redwood-managed with a CMK import?
kyle: They emailed that they need BYO-KMS with HSM-backed keys (AWS KMS multi-region). That will change our deployment plan slightly.
sara: I have the security questionnaire open. Main ask: data-at-rest encryption with customer KMS, audit logs, and proof of SOC2 controls. I can answer most, but need confirmation on KMS key access model and whether logs can be streamed to their Splunk.
maria: Correct — BYO-KMS + ability to export audit logs. Zephyr is pushing on procurement timelines; they want a 2-week POC with an exec bridge to unblock procurement sign-off.
jonas: If it's BYO-KMS we need a short design: (1) KMS key registration API, (2) key usage policy that prevents key import/export, (3) metrics to show no plaintext persists. I can prototype tomorrow if eng prioritizes.
kyle: Estimated effort: 2 engineers, ~3 days to wire KMS registration + small config UI, plus 1 day ops for key rotation docs. Dedicated capacity bump is optional but recommended to meet their latency SLOs.
maria: Pricing ask from procurement: will the Dedicated monthly commit be pro-rated for a 2-week POC? They want an explicit number for exec to approve.
notabot: /deploy status: no active deploys against the zephyr-proto env.
sara: On the questionnaire, I can commit to draft answers for controls 1–6 by EOD if we confirm KMS approach. Need an owner for Splunk log shipping verification.
jonas: I can validate Splunk ingestion—need a sample events schema. Maria can we ask Zephyr for sample event format?
maria: On it. I'll ping them now. @raj can you join an exec bridge tomorrow 10am PT? Zephyr requested C-level presence to finalize procurement.
raj (cto): I can make 10am PT. Before that, we need the pro-forma pricing number. @kyle can you produce a quick estimate (hosted vs dedicated POC) with a conservative buffer for GPU hours?
kyle: Will do. I'll put numbers in a short Google sheet and share link here within 90 minutes.
maria: Action list: jonas = technical DRI (KMS + Splunk sample), kyle = pricing estimate, sara = questionnaire draft, raj = exec bridge. Zephyr contact is elena@zephyr.ai, procurement lead.
jonas: Quick note — for BYO-KMS we should add a policy where keys are only accessible to the inference runtime via a KMS grant; no customer plaintext ever touching our control plane. I'll add that to the doc I draft.
sara: For legal, if we can provide the SOC2 excerpt + attestations and the KMS design doc, I can close 80% of the questionnaire.
maria: Thanks. If we can get those artifacts by end of day tomorrow, I'll escalate pricing to finance for an early approval path.
raj (cto): If finance needs an executive sig, I'm available after the 10am bridge. Let's keep the bridge invite tentative until we confirm the artifacts.
maria: Zephyr replied — will send Splunk sample schema and confirm they can provision KMS key by tonight. Sending invite for 10am PT. :thumbsup: 
notabot: Meeting created: zephyr-bridge — 2025-06-12T17:00:00Z (10:00 PT).
jonas: I'll drop a minimal sequence diagram in the thread after lunch.
kyle: Shared pricing sheet: https://docs.google.com/sheet/d/1a2b3cZephyrEstimate (internal) — brief summary: Dedicated 2-week POC + buffer = $18k, Hosted fallback = $6k.
maria: Great. I'll attach that to the procurement packet. Closing status for now: POC blocked -> in escalation -> artifacts in progress. Will follow up after 10am bridge.
